querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_compcode,
                                      ann_dt,
                                      report_period,
                                      statement_type,
                                      crncy_code,
                                      non_current_gains_losses,
                                      tax_return,
                                      government_subsidy,
                                      capital_occupation_fee,
                                      consolidated_gains_losses,
                                      non_assets_gains_losses,
                                      investment_gains_losses,
                                      impairment_assets,
                                      debt_restructuring,
                                      enterprise_restructuring,
                                      trading_price_unfair,
                                      net_profit_loss_subsidiaries,
                                      expected_liabilities,
                                      onoiae,
                                      other_projects,
                                      non_recurring_gains_losses,
                                      income_tax_impact,
                                      profit_loss_shareholders,
                                      non_recurring_gains_losses1,
                                      s_fa_deductedprofittoprofit,
                                      s_fa_deductedprofittoprofit1,
                                      fairvalue_change_gains_losses,
                                      provision_impairment_reversed,
                                      proceeds_loan,
                                      changes_real_estate_value,
                                      profit_loss_adjustment,
                                      custody_fee_income,
                                      is_published,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_cbondnonprofitloss.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.cbondnonprofitloss WHERE report_period BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
